question.text: The elastic potential energy of a strained body is

options.text: \(\frac{1}{2} \times\) stress \(\times\) strain \(\times\) volume of the body
\(\frac{1}{2} \times\) stress \(\times\) strain \(\times\) area of the body
stress \(\times\) strain \(\times\) volume of the body

solution.text: Hint: Elastic PE $=\frac{1}{2} \times$ stress $\times$ strain $\times V$
